items.body: Claude edited 1 source file 17 minutes ago (1 edit over 29 calls) and nothing has run a test or a build since. The later a failure shows up, the more of the work has to be redone; a test run now is cheap and the files are still in context.
items.evidence: 1 edits since the last check · 17:29 · 29 calls
items.explain: Source edits with no test, build or type-check between them accumulate unverified assumptions; the later a failure surfaces, the more of the turn has to be redone. A test run right after the edit is cheap (its output is short) and lets the model fix the failure while the file is still in context. Reads of an edited file count as a check too — only when Claude re-reads the whole result. Documentation edits and sessions that have never run a test are exempt.
items.fix_prompt: Run cargo test and fix any failures before continuing.
items.foot: goes away after a test run or a read of an edited file

items.name: Edits not tested yet
items.retires_on: a test run or a read of an edited file

items.action: a switch re-writes all context — pick the model early, or switch right after /clear
items.body: At turn 7 the model changed, so 111k cached tokens were written again at the cache-write price, about $2.24. Pick the model at the start of a task, or switch right after /clear while the context is small.
items.evidence: model_changed · turn 7 · 1 named misses this session
items.explain: A named cache miss means the API could not reuse the cached prefix: a model switch (`model_changed`) re-writes the entire context at the cache-write price, a changed tool list (`tools_changed`: an MCP server connecting, ToolSearch loading a deferred tool, a CLI older than 2.1.267 rebuilding the list) re-writes everything after the tools, and a rewritten earlier message (`messages_changed`: a rewind or an edited turn) re-writes from that point. Each is a one-off cost the size of the context; the fix is timing — switch models and load tools early, or right after /clear.
items.foot: a tip, nothing to type · goes away after three turns
items.headline: cache miss: model → fable-5-1 · 111k re-written ≈$2.24
items.name: The cache was rebuilt

items.action_text: Run builds and test suites longer than a minute in the background and keep working meanwhile.

actions.label: Put the fix prompt in the box
actions.payload: Run builds and test suites longer than a minute in the background and keep working meanwhile.

items.body: The command `lorem_ipsum_dolor_sit_a…` ran in the foreground for 2 minutes and Claude waited for it. Builds and test suites that take more than a minute can run in the background: Claude keeps working and hears when they finish.
items.evidence: a foreground Bash call longer than a minute; Claude waited for it
items.explain: A foreground Bash call blocks the turn until it exits. For builds and test suites that take more than a minute, run them in the background (`run_in_background`): Claude keeps working and is notified when the command finishes. Calls Claude Code backgrounded itself do not count.
items.fix_prompt: Run builds and test suites longer than a minute in the background and keep working meanwhile.
items.foot: goes away when Claude backgrounds a command, or after three turns
